people.name: Accad
people.line: An ancient city in Nimrod's kingdom, probably Akkad.

people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Calneh
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, possibly Kullania or Kullanhu

people.name: Erech
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city; part of Nimrod's kingdom

translations.web: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
translations.bsb: His kingdom began in Babylon, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
translations.kjv: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
